text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Please listen, Trainer-san! Just now, my 
tea stalk stood upright, and I drew a 
Great Blessing—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think this is a sign that I can 
conquer the Twinkle Series on pure luck 
alone?! It's all as Lady Shiraoki guides 
me!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
